# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

The reviews I found don't agree on a single winner, so here are the picks by use case. Prices shift often, so check the current price before you buy.

**Best overall for Android: Nothing Ear (3)**
- SoundGuys scored its noise cancelling 8.2/10, better than 69% of earbuds it has measured. It has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging.
- It sells for just under $150 on Amazon.
- Downsides: bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics, and about 5 hours per charge with ANC on.
- [iTech Level's roundup](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/) and [SlashGear's guide](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/) have the Amazon links.

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2 (renewed or on sale)**
- SlashGear says the reviewer found their ANC still excellent, and the transparency mode is the best in the industry. They report seeing them at about $150 or less on sale.
- Apple no longer sells them new, so you'll be buying from third-party sellers. [SlashGear's guide](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- The AirPods Pro 3 have stronger ANC but cost more ($179 at Amazon, per [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)).

**Best for Samsung and Android: Galaxy Buds3 Pro**
- SlashGear lists them new at $134 from Samsung's official Amazon store. They have adaptive ANC, an IPX7 rating and 18 hours of total battery life. [SlashGear's guide](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best value for strong ANC: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro**
- It lists at $149.99. Dealectric says code AFSC20 took $29.99 off at Soundcore's US store when they tested it on 2026-10-22, bringing it to about $120.
- SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10, with LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging.
- Soundcore's newer Liberty 5 Pro is [RTINGS' best mid-range pick](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds), but at $169.99 it's over your budget.
- [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). This is an affiliate link, and the store's checkout price is the final word.

**Best Sony under budget: Sony WF-C710N**
- What Hi-Fi? names it their best budget pick, with controlled bass, and lists it at $119 at Walmart, $128 at Sweetwater and $128 at Best Buy. It has no LDAC. [What Hi-Fi? guide](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)

**Cheapest decent ANC: Soundcore P31i (about $60)**
- It has adaptive ANC, multipoint and IP55 resistance, and a 4.4-star average across more than 8,000 Amazon reviews. The ANC isn't class-leading. [SlashGear's guide](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Worth a look: EarFun Air Pro 4**
- Sound Mavericks ranks it #1 for ANC per dollar. It's a spec-based ranking, with no price listed in the excerpt I saw. [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)

**Skip the AirPods 5 if isolation matters most.** At $129–$149 their open fit can't block as much noise as sealed earbuds. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**My short answer:** on Android, get the Nothing Ear (3) or the Liberty 4 Pro. On iPhone, get a deal-priced AirPods Pro 2. If you want to spend as little as possible, the Sony WF-C710N is a safe choice.

Which phone do you use? That would narrow this down to one pick.
